description: A minimal, embeddable Visual FoxPro 9 stored-procedure interpreter: a tree-walking interpreter for real VFP9 .prg source (PROCEDURE/FUNCTION definitions, control flow incl. SCAN and FOR EACH, VFP dynamic scoping (LOCAL/PRIVATE/PUBLIC), by-value/by-reference parameter passing, ON ERROR/AERROR error handling, generalised &macro execution, #DEFINE/#IF preprocessing) running against a live CrossVault.FoxDbf VfpSession - so .prg code that opens tables, seeks, scans, and writes records operates on the same byte-compatible, Rushmore-optimized engine as the rest of CrossVault.FoxDbf. Runs the data side of real business logic: LOCATE/CONTINUE navigation (full FOR/WHILE + scope, in the work area's index order, with per-area CONTINUE state), an INDEX ON TAG/TO write model (structural and non-structural .cdx, standalone .idx, SET ORDER/INDEX, REINDEX, DELETE TAG, tag introspection), REAL row/table buffering (CURSORSETPROP/CURSORGETPROP Buffering 1-5, TABLEUPDATE/TABLEREVERT, OLDVAL/CURVAL/GETFLDSTATE), SET RELATION/SET SKIP parent-child navigation, auto-firing DBC RULEs and referential-integrity triggers (== VFP9), a REAL multi-datasession model (CreateDataSession/ReleaseDataSession, SET DATASESSION TO n — isolated work areas, SETs, buffering and byte-range locks; ASESSIONS/AUSED), low-level file I/O (the FOPEN/FREAD/FWRITE/FSEEK/FCLOSE family, FILETOSTR/STRTOFILE, ADIR), and a broad runtime function library (string/date/math incl. the ...C string-function variants with single-byte-code-page semantics, arrays, TRANSFORM/VARTYPE/STRCONV/TEXTMERGE, session & index introspection). For running real-world VFP9 business-logic stored procedures on .NET without a Visual FoxPro installation. Note the honest limit: RLOCK/LOCK/FLOCK/UNLOCK/ISRLOCKED/ISFLOCKED take REAL VFP-byte-compatible byte-range locks (honouring SET REPROCESS/MULTILOCKS) so a stored proc coordinating via RLOCK is mutually exclusive with a concurrent VFP client, only the SET REPROCESS TO ... SECONDS wait timing is approximated.
